en: A vintage black‑and‑white photograph of a canal lined with small wooden shacks and market stalls on the left and tall trees on the right. Flat-bottomed boats move along the water, some paddled by standing figures with poles. People sit and work along the canal bank, and low commercial buildings with painted signs can be seen behind the shacks. The scene evokes a traditional canalside market in a rural-urban setting.
